messages:
tara (AE): Heads-up: HarborHealth CFO wants a one-slide risk summary + commercial fallback for tomorrow's exec call. Must cover KMS options, egress throughput/SLA, and procurement-ready retention language. Deadline EOD today.

devin (SE): Short variant for slide: Private = BYOK (CloudHSM / Azure KeyVault). Hosted = envelope keys (customer wrapping key + Redwood-managed root). Direct HSM in Hosted requires product exception & exec signoff.

net-bot: NET ticket NET-5129 opened for VPC peering to 10.44.128.0/22. Current ETA 30-48h.

omar (Infra): Peering still in review. If they need guaranteed throughput we can commit a soft SLA (200 Mbps sustained, 1 Gbps burst) on Dedicated pools only. Hosted traffic via public egress has best-effort throughput; we can add reserved bandwidth on Dedicated.

lara (Legal): Procurement will ask for: 1) short KMS paragraph; 2) retention / logging numbers; 3) SOC2 evidence. Draft KMS sentence below — please confirm wording before I attach to the addendum.

chris (Solutions): Harbor asked for an egress failover plan if peering is delayed (they can't wait). Proposed fallback: temporary SFTP over client-managed bastion into their analytics bucket + signed presigned URLs for ingestion, with integrity checks. Also propose a 6-week migration path to Private if they want BYOK HSM.

devin (SE): Draft bullets for the slide (quick):
```
- Transit: TLS1.3 + mTLS for peered flows
- KMS: Private supports BYOK (CloudHSM/Azure KeyVault). Hosted supports envelope-key integration (customer wrapping key). HSM in Hosted = exception.
- Egress: Dedicated = reserved throughput SLA (negotiable). Hosted = best-effort; recommend Dedicated for PHI.
- Logging: 90d default; extendable via paid add-on
- Failover: SFTP/presigned URL plan + data integrity checks
```

tara (AE): Megan — can you weigh in on the commercial fallback? CFO may push for Hosted-only pricing with Hosted-managed KMS.

megan (VP Sales): Commercial fallback suggestion:
- Option A (Preferred): Private deployment with BYOK, Reserved Dedicated pool: 12% discount on committed usage (2yr) + migration credit of 50k if move from Hosted to Private within 90 days. Includes baseline egress SLA for Dedicated.
- Option B (Fallback): Hosted + Redwood-managed envelope keys with a +4% security uplift. No HSM guarantee. 30-day commitment, volume tiers to follow.
Include an addendum that we can commit to SOC2 attestation and provide audit logs as stated.

lara (Legal): Wording OK. Suggested KMS paragraph: "For Private deployments, Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CloudHSM or Azure KeyVault) and does not possess the ability to decrypt customer ciphertext. For Hosted deployments, envelope key integration (customer wrapping key with Redwood-managed root) is available; inclusion of HSM-backed keys in Hosted requires a written product exception and executive approval." Approve?

devin (SE): Approve with one edit: replace "does not possess the ability to decrypt" with "Redwood will not have the ability to decrypt".

lara (Legal): Accepted edit. I'll add SOC2 link and our standard DPA.

omar (Infra): I'll convert the bullets into a one-slide PDF and attach a short runbook with the S3/SFTP fallback. ETA 90m. NET-5129 status: pending approval, will update when approved.

tara (AE): Great. Action items: Omar creates slide + runbook; Devin finalizes tech bullets; Lara prepares addendum text and SOC2 link; Megan signs off on commercial fallback language. Deliverables due by 18:00 PT today (2026-03-24). If anything slips, escalate to Megan.

net-bot: Reminder: include NET ticket IDs in customer packet.

tara (AE): Thanks all  rocket  closing thread once slide & addendum uploaded.
